startup.scenario: Same live note_test vault; sidebar closed, openOnStartup=false; one warm-up, five reloads. loadPlugin includes script loading/evaluation, onload and CSS. First sidebar includes Git status and layout; first diff includes Git/file reads, MergeView creation and synchronous layout, not final paint. Warm OS/V8 cache; not a full application cold start.
startup.preferences: Existing preferences with all default fields
